categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen S-king Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. focuses on intelligent equipment manufacturing, primarily in three segments: semiconductor equipment, flat panel display module equipment, and core components for intelligent equipment. The company designs, develops, produces, and sells equipment used in semiconductor packaging and testing, flat panel display assembly and inspection, and key components such as linear motors and modules.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including cam pressure control, precision visual alignment, software frameworks, high-precision bonding, flexible screen bending, and vacuum application. It employs modular and flexible production management, combining make-to-order and sales forecast-based production. Core technologies also include SECS/GEM networking, image recognition, robotics and vision integration, pressure precision control, and inkjet printing for OLED panels.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include semiconductor packaging and testing companies, flat panel display manufacturers, and consumer electronics firms. Major clients are well-known industry leaders such as Yangjie Technology, Tongfu Microelectronics, Huatech, BOE, Tianma Microelectronics, Visionox, and Huaxing Optoelectronics. The company serves markets related to semiconductor testing, flat panel display production, 3C electronics, lithium battery equipment, and emerging fields like AR/VR devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations are primarily concentrated in China, with major revenue generated from East China, South China, and Southwest China regions. It also has overseas operations through subsidiaries, including a wholly-owned subsidiary in Singapore. Domestic sales account for over 97% of total revenue, with limited but growing international exposure.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen S-king operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of intelligent equipment and core components used by semiconductor and display panel manufacturers. It extends its industrial chain by producing both equipment and key parts, supporting downstream manufacturing processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes autonomous innovation with significant R&D investment, focusing on semiconductor advanced packaging and testing equipment, Mini/Micro-LED and AMOLED flexible bonding equipment, and intelligent equipment core components. It pursues dual-track R&D: demand-driven development tailored to customer needs and forward-looking projects anticipating industry trends. The company emphasizes patent acquisition, software copyrights, and continuous technology upgrades to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of intelligent equipment and core components. The company mainly uses a direct sales model, supplemented by distribution channels for core components. Revenue recognition occurs upon customer acceptance or delivery, depending on contract terms and product types.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the few domestic enterprises with comprehensive R&D and manufacturing capabilities across semiconductor equipment, flat panel display module equipment, and intelligent equipment core components. It holds a strong domestic market position with recognized brand reputation and stable partnerships with leading industry players. However, it faces competition from global giants in semiconductor equipment and display sectors, with ongoing efforts to enhance technology and market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 509 million, a decrease of 8.82% year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 105.7 million, though the loss narrowed by 8.63%. R&D expenses accounted for 11.14% of revenue. The company has total assets of around RMB 1.61 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of about RMB 810 million. It has experienced revenue fluctuations due to market conditions but continues to invest in innovation and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shenzhen S-king emphasizes delivering technologically advanced, high-precision intelligent equipment tailored to customer-specific needs, supported by strong R&D capabilities and a comprehensive product portfolio. Its products feature high automation, precision bonding, and integration of vision and robotics technologies, enabling improved production efficiency and product quality. The company also offers one-stop solutions from equipment to core components, enhancing customer value through customization, reliability, and after-sales service.
